stockouts-2026.title: 5 ways to eliminate stockouts in 2026
stockouts-2026.description: Stockouts cost e-commerce brands billions every year. Here's how the top 1% of brands prevent them — and the AI tools making it effortless.
stockouts-2026.content: <h2Inner>The hidden cost of stockouts</h2Inner><pInner>In 2026, a 'Sold Out' button isn't just a missed sale — it's a customer lost to a competitor. Research shows 70% of shoppers switch brands after a single stockout. Here's how the top 1% prevent it.</pInner><h3Inner>1. Move beyond moving averages with AI</h3Inner><pInner>Static spreadsheets and 30-day averages no longer cut it. Modern forecasting needs ML that integrates seasonality, micro-trends, and marketing spend. Michi's models analyze 50+ variables to predict demand at 98% accuracy.</pInner><h3Inner>2. Optimize multi-warehouse inventory</h3Inner><pInner>Selling on Shopify and Amazon means fragmented stock. A stockout on Amazon while your Shopify warehouse is full is a visibility failure — not a supply problem. A unified view fixes this.</pInner><h3Inner>3. Dynamic lead time management</h3Inner><pInner>Suppliers aren't always consistent. Integrating dynamic lead times ensures you trigger reorders at exactly the right moment, accounting for logistics delays automatically.</pInner><h3Inner>4. Calculate safety stock scientifically</h3Inner><pInner>Safety stock shouldn't be a gut feeling. Use a service level formula to calculate exactly the buffer needed to cover 99% of demand spikes without tying up capital.</pInner><h3Inner>5. Automate replenishment alerts</h3Inner><pInner>The best strategy fails without execution. Automated alerts ensure your ops team acts the moment a SKU hits its reorder point — no manual checks required.</pInner>

ai-demand-planning.title: How AI is changing inventory planning
ai-demand-planning.description: Machine learning is transforming how brands predict demand and manage their supply chain.
ai-demand-planning.author: Supply chain expert
ai-demand-planning.content: <h2Inner>The era of spreadsheets is over</h2Inner><pInner>Traditional demand planning relies on simplistic historical data and Excel spreadsheets. Today, Artificial Intelligence is revolutionizing this approach by integrating dozens of complex variables in real-time.</pInner><h3Inner>1. Micro-trend detection</h3Inner><pInner>Unlike classical statistical models, machine learning can spot minute variations in purchasing behavior, allowing brands to anticipate unforeseen demand spikes with formidable accuracy.</pInner><h3Inner>2. Integrating external factors</h3Inner><pInner>Weather, holidays, or social media marketing campaigns massively influence sales. AI can assimilate these external signals to adjust forecasts dynamically, avoiding costly overstock or frustrating stockouts.</pInner><h3Inner>3. Continuous optimization</h3Inner><pInner>The main strength of a neural network lies in its ability to learn. Every day, the model compares its predictions with actual sales and adjusts itself to become increasingly accurate over time.</pInner>

multi-channel-guide.title: Multi-channel inventory: the complete guide
multi-channel-guide.description: Master your inventory across all sales channels — without the chaos.
multi-channel-guide.author: E-commerce pro
multi-channel-guide.content: <h2Inner>The complexity of omnichannel</h2Inner><pInner>Selling simultaneously on Shopify, Amazon, and physical marketplaces multiplies your opportunities, but dangerously fragments your inventory visibility. This guide shows you how to regain control.</pInner><h3Inner>1. Centralize inventory data</h3Inner><pInner>The biggest risk of omnichannel is siloed data. If an Amazon order depletes your stock without Shopify being updated, you risk selling out-of-stock items, which is disastrous for your reputation. A single source of truth is non-negotiable.</pInner><h3Inner>2. Allocate intelligently per channel</h3Inner><pInner>Not all channels perform the same way. AI allows you to understand the velocity of each platform and automatically redirect stock to the most profitable channels before they run out.</pInner><h3Inner>3. Master the buffer stock</h3Inner><pInner>Maintaining a common safety stock is no longer enough. Each channel has its own volatility. Define dynamic buffers specific to Amazon FBA versus your own warehouse (3PL) to guarantee optimal service levels everywhere.</pInner>

Blog.summaryContent: AI forecasting, multi-warehouse visibility, and automated alerts are the three pillars of a stockout-free inventory strategy.
